What is PExTAB

One platform, instead of five disconnected tools

PExTAB has spent 15+ years evolving into the platform it is today, and continues to evolve as business requirements change.

PExTAB stands for Platform to Expedite Transformation of Any Business. It is a business process and automation platform: one system where your teams build applications, automate workflows, manage documents and connect the tools you already use.

Build

Applications and processes shaped around how your teams already work.

Integrate

Connections into the systems your business already depends on.

Scale

Room to add new processes and departments as the business grows.

The problem

Most business software is built for the average case

Real processes are full of exceptions that standard applications were never designed to handle. The gaps get filled with email, spreadsheets and manual work, until nobody can say for certain where things stand.

Unsupported approvals

The process moves into email.

Scattered documents

Split across shared drives, inboxes and laptops.

Disconnected systems

Data retyped between systems.

Slow policy change

Weeks to reach the application.

See the AI capabilities
AI in PExTAB

AI that works inside your process, not beside it

PExTAB applies AI where documents slow work down: reading them, sorting them, checking them and routing them. Every result passes through your business rules and, where needed, your people before it reaches a system of record.

Most AI document tools stop at reading. PExTAB carries on, through approvals, exceptions, storage and integration.

Intelligent document processing

Reads invoices, forms, letters, records and scanned files, then turns them into structured data your workflow can act on.

OCR and image clean-up

Converts scans and photos into searchable text, with enhancement for pages that arrive crooked, faded or low quality.

Classification and splitting

Identifies each document type and separates mixed batches into individual documents, so nobody sorts a pile by hand.

Template-free extraction

Pulls fields and tables from documents without building a template for every supplier or format. Training-based models are also available where a use case needs tighter accuracy.

Handwriting and multiple languages

Reads printed and handwritten content across multiple languages, so documents from different regions and teams follow one process.

Email and document intake

Picks up documents that arrive by email, upload, scan or partner portal, and starts the right workflow automatically.

Validation you control

Business rules check every extraction against your policies. Low-confidence results go to a reviewer before anything moves on.

Straight-through processing

Clean documents pass from intake to approval without a manual touch. Only exceptions reach a person.

AI you can govern

For banks, NBFCs, healthcare providers and other regulated organizations, AI has to be explainable, reviewable and contained. PExTAB is built that way.

People in the loop

Human review is part of the workflow, not an afterthought. Reviewers see what the AI read and decide what goes forward.

Your rules, applied every time

Compliance and business rule validation run on every document, so policy is enforced the same way at ten documents or ten thousand.

Your environment

Deploy on-premise, in a private cloud, hybrid, dedicated hosted or selected SaaS. Security controls sit inside your own governance boundary.

A record of everything

Role-based access, encryption and audit trails show who did what and when.

Questions about AI in PExTAB

PExTAB uses AI for the document-heavy steps of a business process: reading scanned and digital documents, classifying them, splitting mixed batches, extracting data and checking it against your rules. The result flows straight into PExTAB workflows and your connected systems.

No. PExTAB supports template-free extraction, so documents with varying layouts can be processed without a template for each one. Where a use case needs higher accuracy, training-based models are also available.

Yes. Human-in-the-loop validation sends uncertain results to a reviewer, while business rules check the rest automatically. Clean documents can pass straight through without a manual touch.

Yes. PExTAB can be deployed on-premise, in a private cloud, hybrid, dedicated hosted or as selected SaaS. Security controls apply inside your own governance boundary, which suits regulated organizations such as banks and NBFCs.

Through REST APIs and integration with ERP, CRM and other tools, extracted data moves into the systems you already use. PExTAB can also feed third-party analytics platforms.

Both. Many document AI tools stop once data has been extracted. PExTAB goes on to route approvals, manage exceptions, store records and connect systems, so the outcome is a finished process rather than a file of extracted fields.

Solutions

What components are available

Three suites run on the PExTAB platform today. Each is built for a specific part of the business.

KareDocs

A document management suite. It brings records out of shared drives and into one governed, searchable system.

Why it matters: fewer lost records, clearer audit trails.

KareFlow

A workflow automation suite. It routes approvals and exceptions automatically instead of through email.

Why it matters: work keeps moving without manual chasing.

KareConnect

A connection suite for partners and systems. It gives external parties a controlled way to submit and track documents.

Why it matters: fewer delays waiting on outside parties.

Applied across: document management, workflow automation, accounts payable, digital medical records, partner document collection and enterprise search.
